body: This recipe app steals recipes from creators and allows people to save them so that they don’t get paid through ad revenue on their blog. It’s wrong and it’s disappointing. DO BETTER

title: Amazing app
body: What an outstanding recipe management tool! The app’s ability to import recipes from my favorite cooking blogs and social media is incredibly useful🤩I also love the filtering feature, which allows me to select recipes based on dietary restrictions, cooking time, or even complexity. 👌🏻Following recipes step-by-step has never been easier, and I often find myself exploring dishes I would have never tried before. I can wholeheartedly say that this app is a game changer for home cooks!

title: Highly recommend
body: I absolutely love this recipe manager! It makes organizing my favorite recipes a breeze. The customizable filters help me keep everything sorted, and I can easily find recipes when I need them. One feature I’d love to see added is a meal planning calendar. That would make it even easier to plan my week ahead!

title: It's 1000% worth it
body: I’m so happy I found this recipe manager! The ease of importing recipes from social media is fantastic, and I can quickly add new dishes to my collection. The filtering capabilities make it simple to find exactly what I need, whether it’s dinner for two or a large family gathering. Following the step-by-step directions has significantly improved my cooking process and made me feel more confident in the kitchen. It's truly a wonderful app for any home chef!
